hooks.text: That giant horizon moon is an illusion inside your head.
The moon on the horizon is physically smaller than overhead.
In 1962, psychologists proved the horizon moon is completely fake.

title: Why the Horizon Moon Looks So Gigantic
description: Discover why the giant horizon moon is an optical illusion created by your brain rather than atmospheric magnification.

beats.text: That giant horizon moon is an illusion inside your head.

beats.text: The atmosphere doesn't magnify it like a lens at all.

beats.text: Refraction near the horizon actually squashes the moon vertically.

beats.text: In fact, the low moon is fractionally more distant and smaller.

beats.text: Extensive experiments in 1962 showed background terrain tricks our distance cues.
You can shrink it instantly by looking upside down through your legs.
